Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: Logical Error in Age Comparison. The Planner correctly identified the birth dates (Keith Bostic: 1961, Jerry Glanville: 1941) but failed to apply the correct chronological logic. The Planner concluded that Jerry Glanville (born 1941) is younger than Keith Bostic (born 1961). This is incorrect because a person born in an earlier year (1941) is older than a person born in a later year (1961). The error stems from a fundamental misunderstanding of how birth years relate to age, reversing the conclusion despite having the correct data.
